info.name: Orange Health Partner Orders Serviceability API

params.name: latitude
params.description: Latitude of pickup location. 13.0240 for sandbox testing.

params.name: longitude
params.description: Longitude of pickup location. 77.6433 for sandbox testing.

params.name: pincode
params.description: Pincode when lat/long unavailable. 560043 for sandbox testing.

items.docs: Check whether a pickup location is serviceable and, when latitude and longitude are supplied, return the available collection slots. When only a pincode is supplied, returns serviceability without slots.
